user.title: Connect to your Pelican site
user.description: Enter your Pelican Site Manager hostname and the credentials of a Pelican user account. Create a dedicated non-personal user in Site Manager under User Management for this.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Pelican
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} were rejected. Enter working credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the site. Check the hostname, DNS, and outbound internet access. See the log for the exact network error.
error.invalid_auth: The site rejected those credentials. Check the user exists in Site Manager under User Management.
error.bad_response: The site answered with something unexpected instead of API data. Check the hostname and that the OpenAPI is available on this account. See the log for details.
error.api_error: The site understood the request and refused it. The reason is in the log.
error.no_thermostats: Connected, but the site reported no thermostats for this user.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Pelican site is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the site. The Pelican API has no rate limit, and one request covers every thermostat.

single_setpoint_in_auto.message: {name} is in {mode}, which uses a heat and a cool setpoint. Set target_temp_low and target_temp_high instead of temperature.

cloud_schedule_active.title: Pelican schedules will override Home Assistant
cloud_schedule_active.description:
{count} thermostat(s) at {site} are running a schedule configured in Pelican Site Manager: {thermostats}.

A temperature set from a Home Assistant automation or dashboard holds only until the schedule's next set time, then reverts. The API call succeeds either way, so nothing appears to fail.

Pelican does not serve schedule contents over the API, so Home Assistant cannot tell you when that will happen or what it will change things to — only that it will.

To let Home Assistant own the setpoints, turn off the Schedule switch for those thermostats. To keep the Pelican schedule authoritative, gate your automations on the Cloud schedule binary sensor. This warning is informational and clears when no thermostat has a schedule running.
